description: Takes rent, price, down payment, loan terms and growth assumptions and returns the year-by-year net worth of buying against renting, with the break-even year. Example input: {"rent":30000,"rentGrowth":5,"price":8000000,"downPayment":1600000,"annualRate":8.5,"months":240,"appreciation":5,"investReturn":10,"years":20}

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, for example 8.5

appreciation.description: Yearly property price growth in percent

investReturn.description: Yearly return in percent if the down payment is invested instead

name: rentVsBuy
